capability.name: AIF Metadata
capability.description: Validates AIF equipment metadata attributes on assets.

requirements.name: properties-sublayer-required
requirements.message: Stage must include a *properties*.usda sublayer for AIF metadata.

requirements.name: asset-class-required
requirements.message: Default prim must have aif:core:assetClass attribute.

requirements.name: asset-identification-metadata
requirements.message: Default prim must have aif:core:manufacturer, aif:core:modelNumber, and aif:core:assetVersion attributes.

requirements.name: physical-dimensions-metadata
requirements.message: Default prim must have aif:core:height, aif:core:width, aif:core:depth, aif:core:weight, aif:core:overallGeometryDimensions, aif:core:installationClearance, and aif:core:accessibilityRequirement attributes.

requirements.name: simready-version-tracking
requirements.message: Default prim must have aif:core:simreadyVersion attribute.

requirements.name: asset-description-required
requirements.message: Default prim must have aif:core:assetDescription and aif:core:connectsToModelDocumentation attributes.

requirements.name: equipment-class-template-compliance
requirements.message: All aif:spec:* attributes defined in the equipment-class schema must be present on the default prim.
